coupling: The lossless sliding-window commit changes the shared VP8LGetWindowRows() allocation from twice the calculated minimum to exactly that minimum. The later alpha-window commit passes one history row to this helper, treating its generic 16-row cache allowance as covering alpha output. At width 1024, the combined calculation allocates 24 rows, but the last VP8 macroblock can request 24 new alpha rows while retaining the preceding row, so a 25th row is written. Either sizing change alone still allocates the full 32-row image for the probe. The repair must reconcile the shared helper allocation with the alpha caller's separate 25-row retention requirement.
